name: fabric-mlv-manager
description: Validate, plan, and orchestrate Materialized Lake View deployments for Microsoft Fabric.

commands.title: Fabric MLV: Toggle Dependency Graph Direction
Fabric MLV: Apply Fabric API Profile
Fabric MLV: Preview Fabric API Profile

fabricMlv.sqlRoot.description: Workspace-relative folder containing MLV SQL files.

fabricMlv.metadataFile.description: Metadata JSON filename inside the SQL root folder.

fabricMlv.requireSchemaPrefix.description: Require SQL filenames to include schema prefix, such as silver.orders.sql.

fabricMlv.enforceSqlBodyShape.description: Validate SQL contains an AS SELECT body and does not include CREATE MATERIALIZED LAKE VIEW.

fabricMlv.dependencyGraphDirection.description: Dependency graph orientation: LR for left-to-right, TB for top-to-bottom.

fabricMlv.fabricApi.url.description: Optional HTTP endpoint that triggers Fabric deployment pipeline or notebook.

fabricMlv.fabricApi.method.description: HTTP method used for deployment trigger requests.

fabricMlv.fabricApi.authToken.description: Optional bearer token for deployment trigger requests.

fabricMlv.fabricApi.payloadJson.description: Optional JSON payload sent to fabricApi.url.

fabricMlv.fabricApi.statusUrlTemplate.description: Optional status URL template with {runId}, for example https://api.example/runs/{runId}.

fabricMlv.fabricApi.pollIntervalMs.description: Polling interval in milliseconds when statusUrlTemplate is configured.

fabricMlv.fabricApi.maxPollAttempts.description: Maximum number of polling attempts for deployment status checks.

fabricMlv.fabricApi.runIdFieldPath.description: Dot path to run id in trigger response JSON, for example data.run.id.

fabricMlv.fabricApi.statusFieldPath.description: Dot path to status in polling response JSON, for example data.state.lifecycle.

fabricMlv.fabricApi.successStates.description: Status values treated as successful terminal states.

fabricMlv.fabricApi.failureStates.description: Status values treated as failed terminal states.
